subject.title: fix(setup): cancel node pairing cleanly instead of a spurious timeout warning + wasted retry

question: Should this PR require current-head proof from the shipped setup cancellation flow and a genuine-timeout run, or is the deterministic loopback pipeline evidence sufficient to waive that requirement?
rationale: The source change is small and the deterministic tests are useful, but the repository policy and prior review request proof of the actual setup/pairing path; only a maintainer can waive that evidence requirement for an unavailable live gateway environment.

options.title: Require shipped-flow proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head setup logs, JSONL, or journal output showing immediate cancellation without a retry warning and a separate genuine timeout retaining normal retry behavior.

options.title: Accept deterministic harness evidence
options.body: Treat the real pipeline plus deterministic loopback and fake dependency coverage as sufficient for this narrow cancellation-only change despite the missing live gateway transcript.

recommendation.title: Require shipped-flow proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head setup logs, JSONL, or journal output showing immediate cancellation without a retry warning and a separate genuine timeout retaining normal retry behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This reviewer specified the outstanding real-flow proof contract and is the strongest available routing signal in the supplied discussion.
